description: This file defines the PHP class 'EC2InstanceConnectClient' which extends 'AwsClient', used for interacting with the AWS EC2 Instance Connect service via methods such as sendSSHPublicKey and sendSerialConsoleSSHPublicKey.

classes.name: EC2InstanceConnectClient
classes.description: Client class for AWS EC2 Instance Connect service, providing methods to send SSH public keys and serial console SSH public keys.

methods.name: sendSSHPublicKey
methods.description: Method to send SSH public key to the specified instance.

methods.name: sendSerialConsoleSSHPublicKey
methods.description: Method to send SSH public key to the serial console.
